ValidationRule.description: The ESG Team and Data Modeller Team should only be able to edit Status and Comments.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(IsSystemGeneratedRecord = FALSE, OR( ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"ESG Team"), ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c ,"Data Modeller") ), OR(ISCHANGED(Name),ISCHANGED(StnryAssetEnvrSrcId),ISCHANGED(FuelType),ISCHANGED(FuelConsumptionUnit),ISCHANGED(Accural_Data__c), ISCHANGED(StnryAssetCrbnFtprntId),ISCHANGED(NZC_Month__c),ISCHANGED(I_have_reviewed_all_fields_and_data__c),ISCHANGED(CarbonFootprintReportDate),ISCHANGED(StartDate),ISCHANGED(EndDate),ISCHANGED(SupplierId),ISCHANGED(FuelConsumption))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Record cannot be edited other than Status and Comments.
